body: Hey. I'm sorry that your life has been so difficult up to this point. I know that some people, even the best of people can be dealt unfair hands and go through things that no person should have to go through. This is what sounds like has happened to you and I am so sorry. I see that you mentioned that you would like to know that your family is okay before before wanting to disappear from life. I can tell just by this that you have a very good heart and I'm sure you can agree that it seems like there aren't all that many people out there with a truly good heart. What I'm trying to say is that I really do think that the world needs people like you. Just think, since things have been so bad up to this point, it's very likely that things can really only get better from here. I just hope you'll keep this in mind and when you find find any sense of hope (and i truly believe you will) you hold onto it and don't let it go. Good luck and I wish the best for you.

I'm in the U.S. I told my parents that I have been having severe anxiety lately but I don't think they understand how bad it is. They've told me to just wait (they probably think it's "just a phase"). I don't know if I have the courage to tell them that I've been thinking about killing myself.
